National.safety_note: National emergency number 112 works across all states in India. Dial 1363 for 24x7 multi-language tourist support.

Telangana (Hyderabad).safety_note: Hyderabad has dedicated SHE Teams for women's safety. 100 and 112 connect directly to the central police control room.

Maharashtra (Mumbai).safety_note: Mumbai operates dedicated Tourist Police squads around Gateway of India and Colaba.

Delhi (NCR).safety_note: Delhi Police Tourist Patrol vans are stationed near major monuments.

Karnataka (Bengaluru).safety_note: Namma 112 vehicles respond rapidly across urban Bengaluru.

National.safety_note: 911 handles all emergency services (police, ambulance, fire) across all 50 states.
Dial 999 or 112 for urgent emergencies. Dial 111 for non-emergency NHS medical advice.
Dial 112 for English-speaking European emergency operators, or 15 directly for medical emergencies.
Dial 110 for police (Koban) and 119 for ambulance/fire. English interpretation is available on 110/119 in major cities.
